purpose: Observe the lifecycle and last execution result of the fixed Gekta baseline unit even when it is inactive. Add a bounded read-only receipt before the unchanged active-service control probe; do not start, restart, repair or change the service.
ownerBasis: The owner explicitly replied «Делай» on 2026-11-20 after receiving the current model outage and source/readiness status. This prospective source-only prerequisite implements that continuation through separate metadata and source acceptance. It is not a runtime command, service-control grant or permission to bypass existing host authority.

prospectiveRenewal.qualification: After this metadata is separately accepted, this prospective purpose supersedes only the older diagnostic-repair-only, exact-payload and output-vocabulary restrictions for the one frozen source transition below. All historical records, state vectors and every other identity, privilege, privacy, review, CI, source and runtime boundary remain unchanged. The old purposes are not reinterpreted.
prospectiveRenewal.scopeGuardQualification: The accepted guard enforces the existing one-path regular-workflow/state predicate. It does not enforce the new before/after payload pins. Independent complete-byte review must enforce this manifest; a private scope PASS is neither admission nor a runtime grant.

failureEvidence.qualification: Exit 3 with no facts strongly points to the initial systemctl is-active check. It does not establish the exact ActiveState/SubState or cause, distinguish failed from inactive, or prove a recovery. The direct transport failure does not establish a broken key or a specific network errno. No raw host output or credentials are included.

boundedChange.placement: After unchanged pinned transport and before unchanged Read bounded control-plane facts
boundedChange.identity: Positive equal real/effective UID before and after the read; the same subject is required
boundedChange.capture: 4096-byte sealed anonymous memfd; stdin and stderr DEVNULL; no raw stdout publication
boundedChange.runnerReceipt: Read at most4097 bytes; require exactly the complete eight-field schema with remote exit0, or one fixed error enum with exit1; reject extra/duplicate/out-of-order/unknown fields or values and mismatched exit codes
boundedChange.enums: Fixed closed lifecycle/result vocabulary. A syntactically bounded unrecognized lifecycle/result value maps to OTHER; an empty Result maps to NOT_SET. Neither is success evidence.
boundedChange.evidenceMeaning: CONTROL_UNIT_OBSERVATION=COMPLETE means only that a typed snapshot was observed. INACTIVE or FAILED remains an outage observation. The old active-service prerequisite and all later29-field control-probe behavior remain unchanged, so the job can still fail after retaining the new receipt in its native log.
boundedChange.emptyPropertyHandling: --all retains empty selected properties such as Result; the property selector remains exactly the same seven fields.
